# SP: System prompt: Srijan's Social Media Manager

Srijan Jaiswal (own) · own ·  · notes: [../SYSTEM_PROMPT.md](../../brain/../SYSTEM_PROMPT.md)

**Core lesson:** Our working playbook: iPhone 15 and tripod filming rules, gym and travel modules, edit blueprint, grade specs, caption rules and the face-check rule.


## Ideas from this source (47)

- **[No intro: topic and number first](../topics/hooks.md#hook-no-intro-payoff-first)** · hooks: Rahul never greets: the topic and a number (price, score, date) are spoken and on screen in the first 1–2 s. Our playbook: open on the most striking frame plus a hook text of 8 words or fewer; no logos, no slow intros.
- **[Hook window: 2–3 s short, 15–20 s long](../topics/hooks.md#hook-window-short-vs-long)** · hooks: Short form gives about 2–3 s to win attention. YouTube long form: about 15–20 s max (the industry says 30 s); the viewer checks it is what they clicked and the right person to hear it from.
- **[Carousel: hook on slides 1 and 2](../topics/hooks.md#hook-carousel-slides-1-2)** · hooks: Instagram re-serves a carousel to non-engagers starting at slide 2, so both slide 1 and slide 2 need a hook (the first two slides reinterpret the video's hook).
- **[Shareability: why would they send it?](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-shareability-test)** · ideas: The key test is whether someone would send it to someone else (relatable, expertise, tutorial, funny, interesting, beautiful). Our playbook ranks sends per reach as the strongest signal for reaching new people.
- **[Gym: wrong vs right split-screen tip](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-gym-wrong-vs-right)** · ideas: Single-exercise tip shown as wrong vs right in a split-screen; high save rate.
- **[Gym formats to rotate](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-gym-rotation-formats)** · ideas: Rotate: "Chest day in 30 seconds" vlog (B-roll + 3–4 exercises with sets×reps on screen), "3 exercises for [muscle]" list, monthly progress series (same angle and light), gym humour/POV, diary voice-over, high-protein Indian meals.
- **[Travel formats: vibe, dump, POV, "nobody tells you"](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-travel-formats)** · ideas: Options: 10–12 s sunset vibe reel, camera-roll dump with text, "POV: your office trip actually turns out fun", "things nobody tells you about [place]" (saveable), scrapbook carousel with location labels, 30–45 s day-in-the-trip vlog.
- **[Office-trip content gets sent to colleagues](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-workplace-trip-shareable)** · ideas: Workplace-trip content is highly shareable because people DM it to colleagues ("we need this trip"); the Khandala caption CTA asks to send it to the colleague who always says "next time".
- **[Name the exact spot everywhere](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-place-specific-seo)** · ideas: Use the place plus the exact viewpoint in on-screen text, caption and location tag ("Khandala Lonavala" pairs well since people search both).
- **[Speed ramps: dead time, beats, top rep](../topics/editing.md#edit-speed-ramps)** · editing: Subtle ramps on browser scrolls and screen recordings remove dead time (L07); the L08 teaser syncs ramps to percussive hits; our gym default ramps into the top rep.
- **[End on a frame that loops](../topics/editing.md#edit-loop-to-frame-1)** · editing: Loopable edits win on watch time; the Khandala reel ends back on the sun and feet so it loops to frame 1.
- **[Cut on the beat or on motion](../topics/editing.md#edit-cut-on-beat-motion)** · editing: Our edit blueprint sets cut rules (on the beat or on motion) and travel uses a wide → close-up rhythm. Khandala cut every 1.5 s, which lands on 80 and 120 BPM beats (2 or 3 beats per shot), so music could be added later.
- **[Length: 7–15 s vibe, 20–60 s value](../topics/editing.md#edit-length-by-type)** · editing: 7–15 s for pure vibe/viral reels (completion + loops), 20–60 s for tutorials and vlogs with value, under 3 min to stay eligible for non-follower recommendation.
- **[Face check before using any frame](../topics/editing.md#edit-face-check)** · editing: Never use frames where the mouth is open or mid-word, the tongue shows, eyes are mid-blink or the angle is awkward; prefer a clear smile, a confident neutral or a candid look-away. The Khandala profile shot was replaced after this feedback.
- **[Which app for which job](../topics/editing.md#edit-app-roles)** · editing: Our defaults: CapCut for heavy edits and grading, VN for precise timeline and keyframes, Edits for final assembly, trending audio and direct posting (Edits exports have no watermark).
- **[Trending audio only when it fits](../topics/sound.md#sound-trending-audio-fit)** · sound: Trending audio boosts discovery when it fits the format: energetic for gym transformations, nostalgic acoustic for travel recaps, spoken for skits; original voice-over builds connection.
- **[Keep text out of the UI zones](../topics/text.md#text-safe-zone)** · text: Reels are 9:16 1080×1920; keep text away from the top ~250 px, bottom ~350 px and the right-side button rail.
- **[Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure)** · text: Line 1 = hook/keyword line visible before "more"; 1–3 lines of story or value; a CTA (send/save); 3–5 hashtags. Khandala used a Hinglish chill reel caption and an English story carousel caption.
- **[Keywords in caption and text over hashtags](../topics/text.md#text-seo-over-hashtags)** · text: Keyword-rich captions and on-screen text ("Khandala sunset point") over hashtags; 3–5 precise hashtags; add alt text, location tag, collaborator tags and a first-comment idea.
- **[Hinglish voice and captions](../topics/text.md#text-hinglish-voice)** · text: Rahul speaks Hindi/Hinglish with English or Hinglish on-screen captions; our caption voice switches between English and Hinglish by theme (Khandala reel: Hinglish, chill).
- **[Covers: payoff frame, number, face, accent](../topics/text.md#text-cover-meme-payoff)** · text: Rahul's meme covers come from the reel's own payoff frame, so the cover promises the ending; covers carry a ₹ number or score, a face and yellow accent. Our playbook keeps one cover style per pillar.
- **[Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade)** · colour: Slightly cooler or neutral, higher contrast, clarity/texture up for muscle definition, shadows lifted only a little, distracting signage colours desaturated, subtle vignette.
- **[Golden-hour travel grade](../topics/colour.md#colour-golden-hour-grade)** · colour: Warm temperature, lifted shadows, highlights pulled to keep the sun's disc, richer oranges/yellows, sky blues nudged to teal, light grain; don't oversaturate greens.
- **[Grade spec: exact sliders, presets per pillar](../topics/colour.md#colour-slider-spec-safe-bold)** · colour: Our grades list exact slider values with a reason each, a safe and a bold version, an orange-HSL skin check, and one reusable preset per pillar (gym = cool/contrasty, travel = warm/golden).
- **[iPhone 15: frame rates, modes, HDR](../topics/filming.md#film-iphone15-frame-rates)** · filming: 4K 30 default; 4K 60 for reps you'll slow; 4K 24 for travel; 240 fps slo-mo for single moments; Action mode handheld; Cinematic mode for B-roll; HDR Video off for heavy grading (no Log/ProRes on the base 15).
- **[Lens choice: 1x low light, 0.5x daylight](../topics/filming.md#film-iphone15-lens-choice)** · filming: The 1x 48 MP main lens is best in low light (gym, dusk); 0.5x ultra-wide only in good light; 2x for portraits and tighter muscle shots.
- **[Lock AE/AF, grid on, clean lens](../topics/filming.md#film-lock-ae-af)** · filming: Long-press to lock exposure and focus, then drop exposure 0.3–0.7 to save highlights; Grid and Level on; clean the lens before every shoot; 48 MP photos for landscapes you'll crop.
- **[Gym filming: etiquette and side light](../topics/filming.md#film-gym-side-light)** · filming: Never film others without consent, don't hog kit, keep the tripod out of walkways; avoid windows and mirrors and let overhead light hit the muscle from the side; film when quieter.
- **[Tripod height changes the story](../topics/filming.md#film-tripod-heights)** · filming: Low (41–60 cm) makes lifts look powerful; chest height is neutral; high (120–133 cm, tilted 10–20°) shows symmetry. A light tripod: thickest legs first, column down, legs spread, bag hung on it, out of plate paths.
- **[Solo: record, then walk in](../topics/filming.md#film-solo-start)** · filming: Start recording and walk into frame (trim later), or use the 3 s/10 s timer; a watch or Bluetooth remote is faster.
- **[Gym B-roll every session](../topics/filming.md#film-gym-broll)** · filming: Walking in, chalk/straps, loading plates, headphones on, pre-workout scoop, pump close-ups, rerack, water sip, mirror check, logging the set.
- **[Two angles per exercise](../topics/filming.md#film-two-angles)** · filming: Move the tripod between sets to shoot each exercise from two angles so the edit can cut between them.
- **[Gym angles: chest, shoulders, arms, abs](../topics/filming.md#film-angles-chest)** · filming: Bench 45° from the foot end at bench height; presses front 45° slightly low; lateral raises from behind; rear delts top-down; arms side-front close-ups and slow-mo last reps; hanging abs in side profile, floor abs top-down.
- **[Gym angles: legs and back](../topics/filming.md#film-angles-legs)** · filming: Squats side-on at hip height; quads low front 45°; RDL from behind; lats from directly behind and slightly low; V-taper high-behind; rows and deadlifts in side profile.
- **[Travel shots: silhouettes, backs, slow-mo](../topics/filming.md#film-travel-shots)** · filming: Silhouettes against the sunset, group walking shots from behind, slow-motion hair/wind moments, wide → close-up rhythm.
- **[Ask before posting faces](../topics/filming.md#film-consent-faces)** · filming: Get a yes from everyone visible before posting or tagging; Khandala media stays outside the repo because colleagues appear in it.
- **[Share CTA: send it to your team](../topics/growth.md#growth-share-cta)** · growth: Caleb closes his course asking viewers to send it to their team on Slack or text it to a friend; our caption rules prefer "send this to…" or "save for your next…".
- **[Reels signals: watch time, sends, saves](../topics/growth.md#growth-ranking-signals)** · growth: Our playbook's order for non-follower reach: watch time/completion and rewatches, sends per reach (DM shares), saves, meaningful comments, then likes.
- **[Collab posts bring new audiences](../topics/growth.md#growth-collab-pillar)** · growth: A regular collaborator making about 4 collab posts a month brings a new audience; our Khandala carousel was planned as a Collab with a colleague, and tags add reach via their networks.
- **[Bio in three lines](../topics/growth.md#growth-bio-three-lines)** · growth: Line 1 what you do, line 2 why follow, line 3 a CTA.
- **[First 60 minutes after posting](../topics/growth.md#growth-first-60-minutes)** · growth: Share to Stories with a sticker/poll (Khandala: a "Guess the point?" poll), reply to every comment, DM it to a few friends who'd enjoy it.
- **[Trial Reels test hooks on non-followers](../topics/growth.md#growth-trial-reels)** · growth: Trial Reels (once 1,000+ followers) test hooks and variations with non-followers before followers see them; Briar names them as a growth tactic without explaining.
- **[Default posting windows (IST)](../topics/growth.md#growth-posting-windows-ist)** · growth: Weekdays 7–9 PM, lunch 12:30–2 PM, weekends 10 AM–12 PM and 6–9 PM, to be replaced by own Insights; Khandala reel planned Thu 7:30 PM, carousel Sun 8 PM.
- **[Originality: no watermarks or near-duplicates](../topics/growth.md#growth-originality)** · growth: No reposted or watermarked clips, no near-duplicates of other creators; trends are a format to adapt, not a video to copy.
- **[Specs: 9:16 reels, 4:5 or 3:4 feed](../topics/growth.md#growth-format-specs)** · growth: Reels 1080×1920, 30 fps (60 for slow-mo sources), HDR off unless the phone's HDR uploads well; feed/carousel 4:5 1080×1350 or the 3:4 grid crop (Khandala carousel 1080×1440).
- **[Edit blueprint per video](../topics/process.md#proc-edit-blueprint)** · process: Our template: theme, format and length, audio, 0–2 s hook, timestamped timeline, cut rules, text, grade, sound design, cover frame, export, app steps.
- **[Theme first, then plan, shots, edit, copy](../topics/process.md#proc-theme-first-workflow)** · process: Our order: research and 3 theme options → content plan → shot list/footage audit → edit blueprint → copy pack → publishing plan → review after 24–72 h.
